purpose: The only ingredient-facing interface a story format should need.

required_inputs.hero_media: One opening visual; format decides crop and timing
required_inputs.product_container: Unbranded bottle, jar, tube, ampoule, or null
required_inputs.citation_ids: Evidence records actually used by the script
required_inputs.boundary_card: The one limitation viewers must retain

optional_inputs.application_media: Usage visual that does not imply an outcome
optional_inputs.mechanism_actor: Only when an approved evidence record supports it
optional_inputs.evidence_cards: One or more scoped evidence summaries

guardrails: A format must never silently substitute an injected-route claim into a topical story.
A generated or reenacted image must never serve as proof.
If a requested claim id is quarantined or missing, render the boundary card instead of inventing a claim.
Use at most three recurring ingredient assets in one video; repetition across videos creates recognition, while variation inside the format preserves freshness.
